title: 宝塚記念の後に・ガラスの天井

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O's acknowledgement of Doto inspires her in the race. She goes full throttle and secures a win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Watching from the sidelines, Air Shakur asserts that the two have reached their full potential—but Opera O's total stats still outweigh Doto's, and neither compare to the previous generation's powerhouses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is there really a ceiling cap to their skills? If so, can it be shattered? We head for the autumn Tenno Sho, weighed down with anxiety.
